loops.minute_1: Player observes 8 rows of static bricks, controls paddle, bounces ball upward. First brick destroyed triggers immediate visual + audio feedback. Action latency under 100ms perceived.
loops.minute_10: Player has cleared ~60% of first brick row, understands paddle third-zones and angle mechanics (yellow 1pt → green 3pt). Second wall accessible. Failure restarts the section. Session cumulative time: 5-8 min typical without errors.
loops.hour_5: Three complete brick rows destroyed (yellow, green, orange). Paddle halved after red row cleared. Score exceeds 100 pts. Precision demand escalates per row. No boss structure—identical wall patterns twice.
loops.endgame: Second wall destroyed; ball bounces empty space indefinitely. Victory condition met (2 walls cleared), but no progression offered. Soft ending: no new challenge, retention drops to zero unless high-score challenge exists.

objectives.victory_condition: Destroy two complete brick walls (48 total bricks)
objectives.defeat_condition: Paddle misses ball three times (lives exhausted)
objectives.player_goal: Maximize score via brick destruction and angle-perfection, clear both walls before losing three lives

games.retention_answer: Score-attack loop (implicit high-score memory per player); 8-15 min per session encourages repeated plays; escalating ball speed creates time pressure. No live-ops, no metagame—pure skill loop.

loops.minute_1: Player controls Vaus paddle, dense brick layout on screen (stage-specific geometry). Collision triggers capsule-drops (Expand, Laser, Catch, Slow). Audio + haptic feedback immediate. Recompense: brick destroyed, possible power-up pickup.
loops.minute_10: After 5-6 min, first chamber cleared. Expand power-up received → paddle doubled size. Psychological reward: perceived mastery increase. Stage 2-3 begins with indestructible grey bricks forming structural puzzle. Layout decision emerges: route-finding for ball.
loops.hour_5: Stages 10-15 reached (~45 min cumulative). Laser paddle + triple-ball active. Floating enemy sprites present (bonus points if destroyed). Stage clarity established: each stage ~3 min, progression visible (13/33 = 40%). Power-up RNG drives session variance.
loops.endgame: Stage 33: Boss 'Doh' (solid block entity). No continue allowed at this stage—game-over is terminal. Victory = Doh destroyed. Tension peak: this is the only stage without continue-credit fallback.

objectives.victory_condition: Clear all 33 stages, defeat Boss Doh on stage 33
objectives.defeat_condition: Lose three lives at any stage except 33; lose on stage 33 with no continues available
objectives.player_goal: Progress through all 33 stages, master variable layouts and power-up timing, defeat the final boss

games.retention_answer: Explicit progression counter (stage X/33) drives completion loop; varied level layouts prevent monotony; power-up RNG creates session-to-session variance and surprise. Arcade-era 'continue-coin' mechanic introduces time-bound social engagement (shared cabinet, spectators).
